correctness.rationale: Checked the original integral (bounded Y ensures moments finite) and the outer integrated Taylor block in Eq. (3.8). Its positive inner m-sum is bounded below by the m=0 term A_n=(2/π)(rλ)^n 2^(n/k) Γ(n/k+1)/n!. Gamma-ratio asymptotics give A_(n+1)/A_n∼rλ(2/k)^(1/k)n^(1/k−1): term test fails for every 0<k<1; at k=1 the exact ratio is 2rλ, so failure whenever ≥1. For k=λ=r=1 the integrated m=0 contributions are (2/π)(−2)^n while the original integral equals 1/2. Expanding only the nonnegative reciprocal-square-root factor and invoking Tonelli gives a globally convergent one-sum integral. Eq. (3.12) reuses invalid nested moment rows. Independently checked numerical integral, beta special case and gamma ratios.
